headline:
Florida insurers just
returned [[$211 million]]
to homeowners
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: The market cooled. Not every bill did.

stats.label: Florida homeowners paid $1.29 billion less in premiums in 2025 than in 2024.
The average homeowners rate increase fell to under 1 percent in 2025, down from 9.6 percent in 2023.
Citizens, the state's insurer of last resort, now holds just 3 percent of the market, down from 15 percent.
